items.prompt: Listen. Radio: Tomorrow will be sunny in the morning, with clouds in the afternoon and rain in the evening. When will it rain?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Match each kind of weather with its time of day.
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: In the evening.

items.prompt: Listen. Boy: Which is cheaper, the red bike or the blue bike? Shop assistant: The red bike costs ninety pounds, and the blue one costs one hundred and ten. Which bike is cheaper?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Ninety is less than one hundred and ten.
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: The red bike.

items.prompt: Listen. Teacher: Although the experiment looked easy, many students made mistakes because they did not read the instructions carefully. Why did students make mistakes?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Listen for the word "because".
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: They did not read carefully.

items.prompt: Listen. Girl: I am not sure whether to study French or Spanish next year. My cousin speaks Spanish, so maybe I will choose that. Which language will she probably choose?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Why does her cousin matter?
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.

items.prompt: Listen. Announcer: The next flight to Singapore has been delayed by forty minutes. It was due at five fifteen. What is the new time?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Add forty minutes to five fifteen.
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: Five fifty-five.

items.prompt: Listen. Man: Not only did we win the match, but we also scored the most goals in the whole league. What did the team do?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Listen for "not only" and "but also".
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: Won and scored the most goals.

options.text: Won and scored the most goals

items.prompt: Listen. Woman: The library will close early on Friday because of a staff meeting, but it will open as usual on Saturday. When will the library close early?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
Listen for "early" and the day that goes with it.
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: On Friday.

items.prompt: Listen. Boy: I was going to wear my new shoes, but they were too tight, so I wore my old ones. What did the boy wear?
hints: Listen to the whole talk first.
He changed his mind. Listen for "so".
Say each choice aloud. Pick the one that matches what you heard.
items.explanation: The right answer is: His old shoes.
